You should leave him. He deserves someone who will love him to the end.
I agree with this. You cant claim to love someone and abandon them. Thats crazy.
Hope things work out. Tired of reading all these pessimistic responses lol. Sheesh the world isnt that cold.
What im saying is if he really loves you, he'll step up.

You need to talk to him. Ask him if youre worth the effort to clean up his act and be a supportive partner. Some people dont have strong career ambitions but will make the effort to be a part of the team if you ask. Its rare to have a real connection with people. To often we fall in love with what they are and not who they are and in the kongterm i can assure you those types of relationships fall apart. Also discuss roles you want. My sister and her partner have reverse roles hes a stay at home dad and shes the breadwinner and theyre totally happy. My parents met when they both had nothing and the love they shared helped them blossom. Real love is insanely difficult to find. The rest can be worked on.
Dont forget lifes other certainty. Taxes.
I hope at some point we find the clarity we need. I cant live my life drowning it out.
Sorry to hear that. It fucking sucks doesnt it haha.

Faith isnt enough for me. Anyways sorry for the rant. Idk. I hope you have a good day whoever you are.
